_doc: Canonical shape of project_context.sr_co_failure_pairs. Producer: backend/app/routers/agent.py (response['project_context']['sr_co_failure_pairs']). Consumer: agent/src/prompts/self-review.ts -> formatSrCoFailurePairsForSrPrompt. Contract tests on both sides load this file; if the shape diverges, both tests must be updated. A byte-identical copy is kept at backend/testing/__fixtures__/sr_co_failure_pairs_contract.json so the backend Docker test (which has no access to agent/) can read it; contract parity test asserts the two files match when both are reachable.
